# Motion partner programs

<!-- Generated by scripts/partner-programs.mjs from data/partner-programs-motion.json. Do not edit by hand. -->

The companies that hold motion: capture hardware, markerless AI capture, animation libraries and motion marketplaces, rigging and retargeting tools, and avatar SDKs. Motion is what turns a rigged three.ws avatar into a living agent, so these are the partners closest to the product. Adobe, Autodesk, Unity, Epic Games, and Meta programs live on the [big-tech page](./big-tech-programs.md).

It is the wide net. The narrower docs stay authoritative for what they cover: [partners.md](../partners.md) is what each live partnership **is** and how to describe it, [opportunities.md](./opportunities.md) is the stuck-item pipeline, [prospects.md](./prospects.md) scores the 3D and avatar ecosystem, and the [listings registry](../listings-registry.md) tracks directories and awesome-lists.

Sibling pages: [big-tech partner programs](./big-tech-programs.md), [ai company partner programs](./ai-programs.md), and [who promotes partners](./promotion-programs.md) across every sector.

**37 programs across 31 companies.** 1 member / live, 21 eligible, not started, 10 verify fit first, 5 retired or closed. We hold at least one membership at 1 of the 31 companies, and 7 of the open programs offer some form of promotion. Last full research sweep: 2026-11-06.

## Using this page

```sh
npm run programs:next -- --sector motion   # the ranked next actions, top 15
npm run programs:due -- --sector motion    # deadlines and expiring benefits in the next 30 days, submissions to chase
npm run programs:promo -- blog --sector motion   # programs that will promote us, by type
npm run programs -- --log <id> --action "Submitted the application" --status submitted --ref <url>
npm run programs -- --benefit <id> --name "Cloud credits" --value "USD 25,000" --state received --received 2026-11-06 --expires 2027-11-06
npm run programs:build                    # regenerate this page after editing data/partner-programs-motion.json by hand
```

`--log` and `--benefit` update [data/partner-programs-motion.json](../../data/partner-programs-motion.json) and rebuild this page in one step. Log every submission the day it happens, with the confirmation link or email subject as `--ref`; log every benefit the day it lands, with its expiry. That is the whole tracking discipline.

**Scores** use the same F·R·A scale as [prospects.md](./prospects.md#how-a-prospect-is-scored): **F**it (5 = already in our code), **R**each (5 = millions of the right users or buyers), **A**ccess (5 = self-serve form, 1 = no public route), summed to 3-15.

## The plan

Every active program sits in exactly one wave. Work the waves in order; inside a wave, work top to bottom (highest score first). A program moves waves only when its status changes, so updating status is how the plan stays current.

### Wave 0: activate what we already hold

Memberships we already have where a benefit sits unclaimed or a next step is open. Zero acquisition cost, so this always goes first. 1 program.

| # | Program | Company | Score | Next action |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | [Sketchfab Data, Download and Viewer APIs, Staff Picks (now owned by KitBash)](https://www.epicgames.com/site/news/kitbash-acquires-artstation-and-sketchfab) | Sketchfab | 13 | Pitch the best showcase uploads for Staff Picks and ask the KitBash team whether a partner or API showcase route exists after the acquisition |

## Who promotes partners

The open programs on this page that will put three.ws in front of their audience: co-marketing, social posts, blog posts, case studies, newsletters, featured placement, events, podcasts, press, or a partner badge. Ranked by promotion value: the program score plus two points for each kind of promotion one ask earns. Ask for the promotion in the same message as the application; it is far easier to get on the way in than after. The cross-sector view is [promotion-programs.md](./promotion-programs.md).

| Program | Company | Promotion offered | How to get it | Status |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| [Blender Development Fund corporate membership](https://fund.blender.org/corporate-memberships/) | Blender | Social posts, Featured placement, Press release, Blog post | Tier dependent: logo/URL from Bronze, social mention and event credit from Gold, press release and tech blog post only at Patron. | Eligible, not started |

| [Rokoko Sponsored Creator Program](https://www.rokoko.com/community/get-sponsored) | Rokoko | Social posts, Featured placement, Event or speaking slot | Apply via the form; Rokoko extends reach through its channels (partial tier) and invites complete-tier creators to livestreams and judging panels. The page gives no guaranteed post commitment. | Eligible, not started |
| [VRM Consortium supporting membership](https://vrm-consortium.org/en/) | VRM Consortium | Featured placement | Members are listed on the consortium site; ask the secretariat about event slots. | Eligible, not started |

## Keeping it true

- **Never set `member` without proof**: an acceptance email, a portal that shows the membership, or a live listing. Record the proof as a `--log` entry with `--ref`.
- **Never upgrade a designation.** Program names and tiers are quoted exactly as the partner writes them; the framing rules in [partners.md](../partners.md#what-the-page-does-not-claim) apply here too.
- **Log the day it happens.** A submission that is not logged did not happen as far as the next person is concerned, and they will submit it again.
- **Re-sweep quarterly.** Programs get renamed, folded, and retired every few months. When a page 404s or redirects, set `closed` with the reason and the date so nobody re-researches it.
- **A new membership** also needs a card on `/partners` and `/partners/benefits` and a row in [partners.md](../partners.md) (see [partner-benefits.md](../partner-benefits.md#editing-rules)).
